mapper.select: select attr_value.id, attr_value.name, attr_value.attr_key_id, ak.name attr_key_name from lease.attr_value join lease.attr_key ak on attr_value.attr_key_id = ak.id where attr_value.is_deleted = 0 and ak.is_deleted = 0 and attr_value.id in (select attr_value_id from lease.room_attr_value where room_id = #{id} and room_attr_value.is_deleted = 0)
